home.title: SouMoster — Indie Game Studio
home.description: SouMoster is an independent Android game studio. Download Road Hopper, Bank Hopper, Time Hopper and Arena Legends, our first action game, free on Google Play. Nitro Racer is in Google Play Closed Testing, and Space Hopper and Lantern Depths are in development. Watch trailers on YouTube @SouMosterGames.

apps.title: Apps
apps.description: Browse SouMoster Android games. Download Road Hopper, Bank Hopper, Time Hopper and Arena Legends, join the Nitro Racer closed test on Google Play, discover Lantern Depths, and follow trailers on YouTube.

about.title: About
about.description: Learn about SouMoster — independent Android games including Road Hopper, Bank Hopper, Time Hopper and Arena Legends (live), Nitro Racer (Google Play Closed Testing), Space Hopper and Lantern Depths (in development). YouTube @SouMosterGames.

beta.title: Join Closed Beta
beta.description: Nitro Racer is in Google Play Closed Testing, and Arena Legends is now live on Google Play. Sign up for the SouMoster tester track, install from Play, and watch trailers on YouTube @SouMosterGames.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Get in touch with SouMoster. Email, Google Play, YouTube @SouMosterGames, and socials.

support.title: Support
support.description: Get help with SouMoster games. Report bugs, request features, or browse our FAQ.

press.title: Press Kit
press.description: SouMoster press kit: studio fact sheet, game fact sheets, logos, icons, banners, screenshots, and trailer links for Road Hopper, Bank Hopper, Time Hopper, Arena Legends, Nitro Racer, Space Hopper, and Lantern Depths.

blog.description: Developer diaries, release notes, patch notes, and announcements from SouMoster.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: Privacy Policy for SouMoster Android games, mobile applications, and services. Compliant with EU GDPR, UK GDPR, Google Play Families, and international standards.

terms.description: Terms and Conditions and End User License Agreement (EULA) for SouMoster Android games, mobile applications, and services.
